name: focus_step_ceiling_snow
about: A 0.125 snow step whose edge is also the edge of a ceiling 2.0 above the floor. 1.7.10 steps up from the plain box by the full step height, hits the ceiling's side and restores the blocked move (stuck at x = 19.7). 1.8.9's swept-box candidate rises only 0.2 and walks under the ceiling onto the snow (minY 64.125).
